arxiv-2111-08889.title: Measuring Geometric Similarity Across Possible Plans for Automated Redistricting
arxiv-2111-08889.creator: Gilvir Gill
arxiv-2111-08889.description: Abstract Gilvir Gill Stony Brook University 1. Introduction Congressional districts in the United States are typically drawn following the decennial census by state legislatures or independent commissions, and the process of redistricting can have a major effect on electoral outcomes.

arxiv-2202-03964.title: RF gymnastics with transfer matrices
arxiv-2202-03964.creator: V. Ziemann
arxiv-2202-03964.description: Abstract We introduce transfer matrices to describe the motion of particles in the vicinity of the stable and unstable fixed points of longitudinal phase space and use them to analyze the transfer of bunches between radio-frequency systems operating at different harmonics and voltages.

arxiv-2203-15023.title: A two-dimensional programmable tweezer array of fermions
arxiv-2203-15023.creator: Zoe Z. Yan 1,∗ , Benjamin M. Spar 1,∗ , Max L. Prichard 1 , Sungjae Chi 1 , Hao-Tian Wei 2,3 , Eduardo Ibarra-García-Padilla 2,3 , Kaden R. A. Hazzard 2,3 , Waseem S. Bakr 1
arxiv-2203-15023.description: Abstract We prepare high-filling two-component arrays of up to fifty fermionic atoms in optical tweezers, with the atoms in the ground motional state of each tweezer. Using a stroboscopic technique, we configure the arrays in various two-dimensional geometries with negligible Floquet heating.

arxiv-2211-07807.title: Hierarchical Inference of the Lensing Convergence from Photometric Catalogs with Bayesian Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2211-07807.creator: Ji Won Park , Simon Birrer, Madison Ueland, Miles Cranmer, Adriano Agnello, Sebastian Wagner-Carena, Philip J. Marshall, Aaron Roodman, the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
arxiv-2211-07807.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ji Won Park , Simon Birrer, Madison Ueland, Miles Cranmer, Adriano Agnello, Sebastian Wagner-Carena, Philip J. Marshall, Aaron Roodman, the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration. We present a Bayesian graph neural network (BGNN) that can estimate the weak lensing convergence ( κ \kappa ) from photometric measurements of galaxies along a given line of sight.

arxiv-2212-05514.title: Slowly rotating quantum dust cores and black holes
arxiv-2212-05514.creator: R. Casadio, L. Tabarroni
arxiv-2212-05514.description: Abstract We study the effect of rotation on the spectrum of bound states for dust cores that source (quantum) black holes found in Eur. Phys. J. C 82 (2022) 10. The dust ball is assumed to spin rigidly with sufficiently slow angular velocity that perturbation theory can be applied.

arxiv-2412-17876.title: Spin identification of the mono-Z ′ resonance in muon-pair production at the ILC with simulated electron-positron collisions at s \sqrt{s} = 500 GeV
arxiv-2412-17876.creator: S. Elgammal
arxiv-2412-17876.description: Abstract In this analysis, we examine the angular distribution of low-mass dimuon pairs produced in simulated electron-positron collisions at the proposed International Linear Collider (ILC), which operates at a center-of-mass energy of 500 GeV and has an integrated luminosity of 4 ab -1 .

arxiv-2512-09878.title: GFH-v2 Pipeline for Searches of Long-Transient Gravitational Waves from Newborn Magnetars
arxiv-2512-09878.creator: Sandhya Sajith Menon, Lorenzo Pierini, Pia Astone, Cristiano Palomba, Lorenzo Silvestri, Sabrina D’Antonio, Simone Dall’Osso, Francesco Safai Tehrani, Stefano Dal Pra, Gaetano Dinatale, Sergio Frasca, Dafne Guetta, Paola Leaci, Alessio Orlandi
arxiv-2512-09878.description: Abstract This paper presents an enhanced methodology for searching long transient gravitational waves associated with a newborn magnetar using a strongly improved version of the generalized Frequency Hough Transform algorithm, called GFH-v2. We describe the main developments introduced relative to the original implementation and outline the optimized parameter-space selection used in the search.

europmc-pmc10786718.title: Multi-ancestry genome-wide association meta-analysis of Parkinson's disease.
europmc-pmc10786718.creator: Kim JJ, Vitale D, Otani DV, Lian MM, Heilbron K, 23andMe Research Team, Iwaki H, Lake J, Solsberg CW, Leonard H, Makarious MB, Tan EK, Singleton AB, Bandres-Ciga S, Noyce AJ, Global Parkinson’s Genetics Program (GP2), Blauwendraat C, Nalls MA, Foo JN, Mata I.

pmc-11574146.title: Delta-like ligand 3 (DLL3) landscape in pulmonary and extra-pulmonary neuroendocrine neoplasms
pmc-11574146.creator: Alejandra G. Serrano, Pedro Rocha, Cibelle Freitas Lima, Allison Stewart, Bingnan Zhang, Lixia Diao, Junya Fujimoto, Robert J. Cardnell, Wei Lu, Khaja Khan, Beate Sable, Aaron R. Ellison, Ignacio I. Wistuba, Kyle F. Concannon, Daniel M. Halperin, Czerniak Bogdan, Kanishka Sircar, Miao Zhang, Kasey C
pmc-11574146.description: Delta-like Ligand 3 (DLL3) targeting therapies are promising in small cell lung cancer (SCLC) treatment. However, DLL3 expression in SCLC and other neuroendocrine neoplasms (NEN) is heterogeneous and not well characterized. We describe the landscape of DLL3 at the mRNA and protein levels across SCLC, large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC), and non-small cell lung cancer.

pmc-12038124.title: What comes after strategy: Moving beyond statements and open letters – An analysis of three Toronto hospitals’ diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) plans
pmc-12038124.creator: Bilal Noreen Khan, Marlena Dang-Nguyen, Dara Gordon, Shivani Chandra, Ibukun-Oluwa Omolade Abejirinde
pmc-12038124.description: IntroductionThe murders of Breonna Taylor and George Floyd in 2020 forced institutions to publicly acknowledge systemic racism. In the Canadian healthcare sector, some hospitals used this pivotal moment to create strategic equity plans to address anti-Black racism and ongoing health inequities.

pmc-12492973.title: Diagnostic and therapeutic appropriateness in different stages of esophageal/GEJ cancers. The FICOG project
pmc-12492973.creator: Carmine Pinto, Carlo Castoro, Ferdinando De Vita, Alberto Gianluigi Luporini, Evaristo Maiello, Renzo Mazzarotto, Aldo Scarpa, Riccardo Caccialanza, Angela Damato,
pmc-12492973.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEsophageal cancer is a rare neoplasm, with more than 0.6 million new cases and 0.54 million deaths worldwide in 2020. The distal third of the esophagus and the gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) are mostly involved sites.

pmc-12619453.title: Low-dose oral misoprostol vs. oxytocin in premature rupture of membranes at ≥ 36 weeks: a comparison of labor induction outcomes and postpartum hemorrhage risk
pmc-12619453.creator: Yike Yang, Zhiheng Yu, Huifeng Shi, Yan Wang, Yangyu Zhao
pmc-12619453.description: BackgroundPremature rupture of membranes (PROM) at ≥ 36 weeks elevates intrauterine infection risks, making timely labor induction the preferred intervention. While oxytocin infusion remains the conventional approach, its efficacy proves suboptimal in cases with unfavorable cervical conditions. Oral low-dose misoprostol emerges as a promising solution.

pmc-12764199.title: Analysis of the Present Status and Influencing Factors of Early Postoperative Kinesiophobia in Patients with Head and Neck Cancer: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12764199.creator: Ze-Ying Hu, Guan-Mian Liang, Jian-Wen Hou
pmc-12764199.description: PurposeThe purpose of this study was to investigate the status and influencing factors of kinesiophobia in patients during the early postoperative period following head and neck cancer (HNC) surgery.Patients and MethodsThis prospective cross-sectional study employed convenience sampling to recruit 367 patients undergoing radical head and neck surgery between September 1, 2024, and April 30, 2025.

pmc-13234053.title: Clinical performance of an innovative self-cure bulk-fill composite compared to dual-cure and light-cure bulk-fill composite in posterior restorations: a 1-year randomized controlled clinical trial
pmc-13234053.creator: Marwan Abdelnasser Ragab, Waleed A Elmahy, Marihan Elgayar
pmc-13234053.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesTo evaluate and compare the 1-year clinical performance of self-cure, dual-cure, and light-cure bulk-fill composites in class II restorations.Materials and methodsTwenty patients received sixty direct class II restorations, which were divided into three groups (n = 20): Group I: Self-cure bulk-fill (Stela capsules) with Stela primer, Group II: Dual-cure bulk-fill (Fill-Up) with ParaBond adhesive system, Group III: Light-cure bulk-fill (Tetric N-Ceram Bulk Fill) with Tetric N-Bond Universal adhesive.

pmc-13369210.title: Element Profiling and Probabilistic Health Risk Assessment of Cornelian Cherry Tarhana: The Role of Fermentation and Alternative Flours
pmc-13369210.creator: Erkan Yalçın, Betül Cındık, Akif Arı, Pelin Ertürk-Arı, Seda Karasu-Yalcin, Eftade O. Gaga
pmc-13369210.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cornelian cherry tarhana (CCT) is a traditional wheat flour-based powder product used for preparing ready-to-drink soup refreshment in Türkiye. On the other hand, the composition of this food material remains largely uncharacterized regarding its multi-elemental profile and safety. This study provides the first comprehensive elemental characterization of CCT using ICP-MS/MS, uniquely integrating fermentation-driven mineral dynamics with utilization of alternative flours and probabilistic health risk assessment.
